scope: bounded gameplay factual-family review; no per-location inventory, presence, ownership, access or materialization whitelist

flora-trees.note: Grounded tree examples/material contexts; missing factual dimension is ecological/seasonal functional coverage beyond willow and selected worked trees.

flora-shrubs-herbs-aquatic.note: Grounded reed, willow and named shrub safety evidence; missing factual dimension is broader aquatic/herb functional coverage for gathering or habitat interpretation.

flora-toxic-and-food-plants.note: Grounded named poison and look-alike cautions; missing factual dimension is non-fungal edible-versus-toxic plant identification rules.

flora-fibre-taxonomy.note: Grounded flax/hemp and plant-fibre processing; missing factual dimension is which additional wild local plant families yield usable fibre.

shelter-interior-space.note: Grounded house envelope, vestibule, oven, underfloor storage and furniture; missing factual dimension is interior spatial-function relationships beyond those elements.

storage-ventilation-and-drying.note: Grounded drying/storage condition evidence; missing factual dimension is storage ventilation/condensation and food-spoilage practice as a joined family.

fishing-net-boat-care.note: Grounded net components, net work, boat context and repair clamp; missing factual dimension is wet-use wear, drying and recurring net/hull maintenance.

riparian-substrate-and-debris.note: Grounded sediment, clay transport and saturation; missing factual dimension is debris/drift material formation and seasonal retention at shore.

npc-occupation-location-and-access.note: Occupation evidence is factual; current entity presence, controller, access and permission remain materialization/code-owned.

fire-extinguishing-water.note: Heat transfer, vaporization and combustion prerequisites ground qualitative water cooling/suppression; missing factual dimension is a dedicated applied extinguishing outcome family for this game context.

remaining_factual_gaps: Tree ecological/seasonal functional coverage beyond the named/used species.
Aquatic/herb functional coverage and non-fungal edible-versus-toxic plant identification.
Wild fibre-plant family applicability beyond flax/hemp.
Interior spatial-function relationships; storage ventilation/condensation/spoilage; wet-use net/hull maintenance.
Applied water-extinguishing outcome semantics beyond general cooling, phase-change and combustion-prerequisite claims.
code_owned_exclusions: current presence, quantity, ownership, topology, controller, permission and access
ordinary container contents when no committed causal basis exists
exact fire-profile execution, numeric mechanics and committed effects
